The run re-ran the pre-enrichment 514f reef config (classifier_loss_weight=0.1, ~0.4% consumption): the identity classifier gets only ~30-50 gradient updates over 9,000 steps and the consumption probe is starved (n=45-72), so the waking pass never encoded consumption-identity for sleep to consolidate. Sleep substrate fired (SWS/REM writes 160/40) but has nothing to etch -- a missing-dependency signature (consolidation is downstream of encoding; Lansink/Stickgold/Walker), not a falsification. 514m already recovered identity to probe 0.926 (n=3,455) with sleep OFF once foraging-competence was scaffolded, so the sleep hypothesis targeted a symptom of the wrong root cause. Seed 44 was a truncated run (12-15% of steps). The manifest's per-claim 'supports' for SD-049 (noise-OR C3b) and SD-017 (SWS/REM-write liveness) are vacuous and NOT counted; SD-017 stays stable/unchanged (its genuine support is V3-EXQ-691).
